rows.phrase: His character must be worn as a lamen before the one who calls him forth, or he will not do homage
Hold the magical ring near your face against his breath, and wear his seal as a lamen or he will not appear or obey
Call him abroad, standing, with cap or head-dress off
a silver ring is worn on the middle finger of the left hand, held against the face
Use a ring in calling him, as with Beleth
Never speaks truth unless compelled or brought up within a triangle
Must first be commanded into a triangle, or he deceives and tells many lies
if he is not commanded into a triangle he lies
If called alone, he must be made some offering
must have offerings, sacrifices and gifts presented by the exorcist or he will not give true answers
Receives sacrifice kindly and willingly but deceives the one who offers it
He sings many sweet notes before the exorcist, which the exorcist must not heed
